therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: BTK inhibition + PD-1 checkpoint blockade + CD19/CD3 T-cell engagement
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell receptor signaling inhibition, T-cell activation, and targeted B-cell elimination
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of Participants With a Response (CR + PR)

results.dose_information: Ibrutinib 420mg/day continuously, Nivolumab 240mg IV every 2 weeks then 480mg every 4 weeks, Blinatumomab 9mcg/day days 15-21, 28mcg/day days 22-28, 112mcg/day days 29-42
